So today I went to have lunch by myself at my favorite gluten-free restaurant and a handsome gentleman sits at the table next to me and he’s super-smooth and charming and the waitress whispers to me, “That’s the lead singer from Earth, Wind and Fire.”

I had a little freak out.

Also this is true.
